items.label: Fabric and Pattern
items.value: YEMYHOM Ottoman Slipcover is crafted from 85% Polyester and 15% Spandex jacquard material, soft and skin-friendly to touch, breathable and comfortable when you sit on, durable and wear-resistant during your usage. The high quality covers for footrest and footstool is designed with 0.6 by 0.6 inches upgraded large checks that would be an eye catching for your guests in your home

items: Perfect Fit：This ottoman protector is elastic enough to fit most ottomans and foot rest. Small, medium, large, oversized, square or rectangular type. Small Size is suiable for 28"-34" length, 18"-25" width, 14"-20" height. Large Size is suiable for 35"-45" length, 23"-33" width, 14"-20" height. Extra Large Size is suiable for 46"-56" length, 23"-33" width, 14"-20" height. Round-M Size is suitable for 12"-19" length, 12"-19" width, 15"-17" height. Round-L Size is suitable for 18"-25" length, 18"-25" width, 15"-17" height. Please measure your ottoman before purchase.

items.label: Full Protection
items.value: The super stretchable bands at the ottoman bottom provides the all round coverage and skid resistance, preventing daily stains, scuffs and naughty kids, as well as cat scratch, dog bites and furs if you have an energetic pet in your home. With this premium ottoman cover, no worries for you, as it will not only be functional to protect your old furniture, but also add sophistication & elegance to your home decor.

items.label: Easy Installation & Clean
items.value: Strapless design makes the fitted ottoman slip cover relaxing to cover the ottoman from one bottom end to the other bottom end, wrinkle-free and no need help from others. Specific Installation Guide of the universal footstool slipcovers is displayed in the listing. WASH TIPS: machine washable, separately in cold water on the gentle cycle, no bleaching, no ironing

items.label: Ultra-high Support
items.value: We are proud of the quality of our magical stylish footstool protector and we know you'll love it. This is why we back it with sum total returns, to help you buy with confidence. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us. We are always here and glad to assist you.
